description:
Ferdi is a writer renowned across the continent for his erotic novels.
However, surprisingly, this sensational author
is Vivian, a quiet woman working as a night librarian at the Imperial Library.

While every new release has been a hit and garnered enthusiastic love from readers,
her fourth work is facing a barrage of harsh criticism for its sexual descriptions being too dry, unlike her previous works. The problem is not merely her writing skill.

Vivian was bound by a long-standing covenant to remain a virgin, and consequently, she had been writing without any direct personal experience.
Outwardly elegant and calm,
her life had been one where she had to suppress even her own desires.

Then, one day, while she was working the night shift at the library, Aiden—the Emperor's older brother and the ruthless prince of the court—visits her, and her daily life begins to shake.
Aiden is known as a cold and distant figure.
However, in front of Vivian, he is strangely affectionate and
begins to take an interest in her secret.
And he says,

“I can break that contract for you.”
